items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: I heard this big band many times when they were touring in Sweden, but I really liked it a lot.

ctx.x: Did he ever talk about that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

Not really, but he had some great offers. Maybe he wanted to do something by himself. I think the big band he and Mel [Lewis] had was the greatest big band, really. At least at that time, with all those soloists. The reed section, Joe Henderson and Pepper and Jerry Dodgion and Jerome Richardson.
